meta.title: Why Alkaline Water? Benefits and Composition
meta.description: Find out why AMULET alkaline water (pH 8.2) is a healthy choice: lab-tested mineral composition, protected source, ISO 9001/14001 certifications.

why.title: Why alkaline water?
why.intro: AMULET alkaline water comes from protected natural sources and has a pH of 8.2, above the level of ordinary tap water or most bottled waters.
why.point1Text: An alkaline pH (above 7) helps balance the acidity common in modern diets.
why.point2Text: Contains bicarbonate, calcium, sodium and magnesium in natural proportions, with no artificial additives.
why.point3Text: The molecular structure of alkaline water may support more efficient hydration throughout the day.
why.point4Text: Natural alkaline mineral water from the B-128 spring, Mezőkovácsháza, carefully captured and bottled to preserve the water's natural purity.
why.point5Text: AMULET water is tested by the accredited Aqua Labor laboratory (Hungary) and produced in accordance with the ISO 9001 (quality management) and ISO 14001 (environmental management) standards. The packaging is BPA-free, and the 1.5L bottles contain 30% recycled material.
why.compositionSource: Lab analysis by the accredited Aqua Labor laboratory (Hungary), at the B-128 spring, Mezőkovácsháza.
why.disclaimer: The information above is general in nature and does not replace medical advice. For personalized recommendations, consult a specialist.

meta.title: Frequently Asked Questions about AMULET Alkaline Water
meta.description: Answers about delivery, the SGR deposit, the 19L container and paying for AMULET orders.

items.question: What is the minimum amount for free delivery?
items.answer: Home delivery is free for orders over 150 RON. Below that amount, we'll contact you to arrange delivery.

items.question: Which days do you deliver?
items.answer: We deliver in Salonta and the surrounding area (approx. 50 km radius) Monday to Thursday, in Oradea on Monday and Wednesday, and in Arad on Thursday.

items.question: What is the 0.5 RON deposit on the 1.5L bottles?
items.answer: It's the national SGR (Deposit-Return System) deposit, mandatory nationwide for PET packaging. It can be redeemed at any SGR collection point in the country, not just from us.

items.question: What quantity are the 1.5L bottles sold in?
items.answer: The 1.5L bottles are sold individually. For reference, 6 bottles make up one pack — at checkout we automatically show you the pack equivalent.

items.question: Is the 19L container returnable?
items.answer: Yes, the 19L containers are reusable. The 35 RON price applies when you hand over an empty container at delivery; without an exchange container, the price is 75 RON.

items.question: Does the 19L container have a handle?
items.answer: The delivered container may have a handle or not, depending on available stock. This variant cannot be chosen by the customer.

items.question: How do I pay for my order?
items.answer: Payment is made on delivery, in cash or as arranged by phone. We do not currently process online payments on the site.

items.question: Can I order for a company, office or school?
items.answer: Yes, we offer recurring deliveries for offices, schools and gyms. Contact us for a tailored offer.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This page explains what data is stored in your browser when you visit the amulet.ro website.

sections.title: 1. What we use
sections.body: Our website does NOT use advertising or marketing tracking cookies. We only use strictly necessary local storage (localStorage) and a cookie-free analytics tool, described below.

sections.title: 2. Visitor analytics (Vercel Analytics)
sections.body: We use Vercel Analytics to understand how many visitors the website has and which pages are most popular. This tool does not use cookies and does not collect personal data or identifiers that would track you across other sites.

sections.title: 3. What local storage is used for
sections.body: Shopping cart: remembers the products added to your cart between visits, for your convenience. Order data: if you complete an order, the name, phone, email, city and address you entered are stored locally so you don't have to re-enter them next time.

sections.title: 4. How to delete this data
sections.body: You can delete this data at any time from your browser settings (the option to clear site data), or by browsing in a private/incognito window.

sections.title: 5. Future updates
sections.body: If we introduce marketing or advertising tools in the future that require cookies, this page will be updated and, where required, we will ask for your explicit consent.
